```json
}
```

```json
{
  "symbol": "<resolved_ticker>"
}
```

2. **Ask me to add the ticker to your watchlist** so you can keep an eye on it easily.  
   ```json
   {
     "stock": "<resolved_ticker>"
   }
   ```

Let me know what you’d like to do next!
